summary: Maple Peak lookout site, Shoshone County: L-4 cab from 1938, moved to Sunset Peak in 1950; only a rock foundation remains; road and hiking access.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a rock foundation (cab moved to Sunset Peak in 1950)
facts.status_note: Cab moved to Sunset Peak in 1950; only the rock foundation remains at Maple Peak. No source says what became of the moved cab.

access.note: Road reaches the point; a hiker describes a spur road and a hiking route. No closure or permit rule in the pages read. Road condition not confirmed.

visit.trail_note: About 8 miles one way: roughly 6 miles on the State Line Trail from Thompson Pass, then a 2-mile road walk on the Maple Peak spur road.

events.note: Site received an L-4 cab. Register's Built field says 1950 (see corrections)

Registered September 18, 2019; nominated by Tom Taylor

corrections.why: Brief's 1950 comes from the register's Built field. firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date the L-4 cab to 1938 and its move to Sunset Peak to 1950; willhiteweb says the same. 1950 is the move year.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register's Built field says 1950, but its own description puts the move to Sunset Peak in 1950; firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and willhiteweb date the cab to 1938. Adopted 1938 as the build and 1950 as the move.
5,750 ft on firetower.org, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; willhiteweb gives 5,760 feet. Adopted 5,750 ft (1,753 m).

notes_for_editor: Brief's 1950 'built' is the move year; corrected to 1938 build. Sunset Peak: the L-4 cab went there in 1950, but no source says what became of it; Sunset Peak got a concrete two-story cab in 1957, and both Idaho Fire Lookouts ('Destroyed/Repurposed', 1975) and firetower.org ('long gone') describe the later lookout only. Access 'public' is an inference from a hiker's route account plus the 'Drive-Up' tag; no closure or permit notice was found, and road condition is unconfirmed. Maple Peak is in the Coeur d'Alene NF per both register and firelookout.com; the brief's agency (USFS) is consistent. Sunset Peak is listed as administered by the Idaho Department of Natural Resources on the firetower.org Sunset page (not used for this record). Not checked: the USFS Clearwater/CDA lookout list at fs.usda.gov/media/259184. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the 5,750 ft figure is now cited only to the three sites that give it; willhiteweb says 5,760 ft and is not cited for elevation.
